questions.t: İstanbul hangi yıl fethedildi?
questions.e: In which year was Constantinople conquered?
questions.xe: Mehmed II took the city on 29 May 1453.

questions.t: Fatih Sultan Mehmed İstanbul'u fethettiğinde kaç yaşındaydı?
questions.e: How old was Mehmed the Conqueror when he took Constantinople?
questions.xe: Born in 1432, he was 21 at the conquest.

questions.t: Osmanlı Devleti'nin kurucusu kimdir?
questions.e: Who founded the Ottoman state?
questions.x: Devlet adını kurucusu Osman Gazi'den alır.
questions.xe: The state takes its name from its founder, Osman.

questions.t: Kanuni Sultan Süleyman kaç yıl tahtta kaldı?
questions.e: How many years did Suleiman the Magnificent reign?
questions.xe: From 1520 to 1566, 46 years: the longest reign.

questions.t: Mohaç Meydan Muharebesi hangi yıl yapıldı?
questions.e: In which year was the Battle of Mohács fought?
questions.x: Macaristan kralı II. Layoş 1526'da Mohaç'ta yenildi.
questions.xe: King Louis II of Hungary was defeated at Mohács in 1526.

questions.t: Preveze Deniz Savaşı'nda Osmanlı donanmasını kim komuta etti?
questions.e: Who commanded the Ottoman fleet at the Battle of Preveza?
questions.xe: In 1538 Barbarossa defeated the Holy League fleet at Preveza.

questions.t: Mimar Sinan hangi caminin “ustalık eserim” olduğunu söyledi?
questions.e: Which mosque did Mimar Sinan call his “masterpiece”?
questions.x: Edirne'deki Selimiye'yi Sinan ustalık eseri saydı.
questions.xe: Sinan regarded the Selimiye in Edirne as his masterwork.

questions.t: Yavuz Sultan Selim 1517'de Kahire önlerinde Memlükleri hangi savaşta yendi?
questions.e: In which battle near Cairo did Selim I defeat the Mamluks in 1517?
questions.xe: Ridaniye brought Egypt under Ottoman rule.

questions.t: Halifelik Osmanlılara hangi padişah döneminde geçti?
questions.e: Under which sultan did the caliphate pass to the Ottomans?
questions.xe: After the Egyptian campaign, in 1517.

questions.t: 1402 Ankara Savaşı'nda Yıldırım Bayezid kime yenildi?
questions.e: To whom did Bayezid I lose at the Battle of Ankara in 1402?
questions.xe: Defeated by Timur, Bayezid was taken prisoner.

questions.t: Lale Devri hangi padişah döneminde yaşandı?
questions.e: Under which sultan did the Tulip Era take place?
questions.xe: 1718 to 1730, in the reign of Ahmed III.

questions.t: Lale Devri'nin sadrazamı kimdi?
questions.e: Who was the grand vizier of the Tulip Era?
questions.xe: Damat Ibrahim Pasha was grand vizier from 1718 to 1730.

questions.t: Lale Devri hangi isyanla sona erdi?
questions.e: Which revolt ended the Tulip Era?
questions.xe: The Patrona Halil Revolt of 1730 closed the era.

questions.t: Osmanlı'da Türkçe kitap basan ilk matbaayı kim kurdu?
questions.e: Who founded the first press printing books in Ottoman Turkish?
questions.xe: Müteferrika's press opened in 1727.

questions.t: Topkapı Sarayı'nı hangi padişah yaptırdı?
questions.e: Which sultan had Topkapı Palace built?
questions.xe: Mehmed II built it in the 1460s after the conquest.

questions.t: Padişah katılmadığında Divan-ı Hümayun'a kim başkanlık ederdi?
questions.e: Who chaired the Imperial Council when the sultan was absent?
questions.xe: From Mehmed II onwards the grand vizier presided.

questions.t: Divan'da devletin mali işlerinden kim sorumluydu?
questions.e: Who handled state finances in the Imperial Council?
questions.x: Defterdar, hazinenin gelir ve giderine bakardı.
questions.xe: The defterdar oversaw treasury income and spending.

questions.t: Padişahın tuğrasını belgelere çeken Divan üyesi kimdi?
questions.e: Which council member drew the sultan's tughra on documents?
questions.xe: The nişancı inscribed the tughra on decrees.

questions.t: Yeniçeri Ocağı'nı hangi padişah kaldırdı?
questions.e: Which sultan abolished the Janissary Corps?
questions.xe: In 1826, the 'Auspicious Incident'.

questions.t: Bağdat'ı 1638'de geri alan padişah kimdir?
questions.e: Which sultan retook Baghdad in 1638?
questions.x: IV. Murad Bağdat Seferi'ni bizzat yönetti.
questions.xe: Murad IV led the Baghdad campaign in person.

questions.t: Viyana'yı ilk kez (1529) hangi padişah kuşattı?
questions.e: Which sultan first besieged Vienna, in 1529?
questions.xe: Suleiman lifted the siege as winter set in.

questions.t: 1683 İkinci Viyana Kuşatması'nda Osmanlı ordusunu hangi sadrazam yönetti?
questions.e: Which grand vizier led the army at the second siege of Vienna in 1683?
questions.x: Yenilgiden sonra Kara Mustafa idam edildi.
questions.xe: Kara Mustafa was executed after the defeat.

questions.t: Karlofça Antlaşması hangi yıl imzalandı?
questions.e: In which year was the Treaty of Karlowitz signed?
questions.xe: The first major Ottoman loss of territory.

questions.t: Bursa hangi padişah döneminde fethedildi?
questions.e: Under which ruler was Bursa conquered?
questions.xe: Taken in 1326, Bursa became the capital.

questions.t: Edirne'yi alıp başkent yapan padişah kimdir?
questions.e: Which sultan took Edirne and made it the capital?
questions.xe: Edirne stayed the capital until Constantinople fell.

questions.t: 1389 Kosova Savaşı'nda şehit düşen padişah kimdir?
questions.e: Which sultan was killed at the Battle of Kosovo in 1389?
questions.x: Savaş kazanıldı ama I. Murad savaş alanında öldürüldü.
questions.xe: The battle was won, but Murad I was killed on the field.

questions.t: Kanuni Sultan Süleyman Avrupa'da hangi lakapla anılır?
questions.e: By what epithet is Suleiman known in Europe?
questions.xe: His own people called him the Lawgiver; Europe, the Magnificent.

questions.t: Evliya Çelebi'nin ünlü eserinin adı nedir?
questions.e: What is the name of Evliya Çelebi's famous work?
questions.xe: A travel account in ten volumes.

questions.t: Katip Çelebi'nin dünya coğrafyası kitabının adı nedir?
questions.e: What is Katip Çelebi's book of world geography called?
questions.xe: Cihannüma was later printed by Müteferrika's press.

questions.t: Piri Reis'in denizcilik kitabının adı nedir?
questions.e: What is Piri Reis's book of navigation called?
questions.xe: It describes the Mediterranean coasts with charts.

questions.t: Piri Reis'in ünlü dünya haritası hangi yıl çizildi?
questions.e: In which year did Piri Reis draw his famous world map?
questions.x: Haritada Amerika kıyıları da yer alır.
questions.xe: The map includes the coasts of the Americas.

questions.t: Kanuni döneminin ünlü Şeyhülislamı kimdir?
questions.e: Who was the famous Şeyhülislam of Suleiman's reign?
questions.xe: Ebussuud held the office from 1545 to 1574.

questions.t: Hürrem Sultan hangi padişahın eşiydi?
questions.e: Hürrem Sultan was the wife of which sultan?
questions.xe: Suleiman formally married her.

questions.t: IV. Murad'ın annesi kimdir?
questions.e: Who was the mother of Murad IV?
questions.x: Kösem Sultan, IV. Murad ve İbrahim'in annesiydi.
questions.xe: Kösem was the mother of Murad IV and Ibrahim.

questions.t: Sokullu Mehmed Paşa kaç padişaha sadrazamlık yaptı?
questions.e: How many sultans did Sokollu Mehmed Pasha serve as grand vizier?
questions.x: Kanuni, II. Selim ve III. Murad.
questions.xe: Suleiman I, Selim II and Murad III.

questions.t: Sokullu Mehmed Paşa hangi iki nehri kanalla birleştirmek istedi?
questions.e: Which two rivers did Sokollu plan to join with a canal?
oe: the Nile and the Red Sea
questions.xe: Digging began in 1569 but was never finished.

questions.t: 1514 Çaldıran Savaşı Osmanlılar ile kim arasında yapıldı?
questions.e: Whom did the Ottomans fight at Chaldiran in 1514?
questions.xe: Selim I defeated Shah Ismail.

questions.t: 1516 Mercidabık Savaşı kime karşı kazanıldı?
questions.e: Against whom was the Battle of Marj Dabiq won in 1516?
questions.xe: This victory brought Syria under Ottoman rule.

questions.t: Osmanlı akçesi hangi madenden basılırdı?
questions.e: What metal was the Ottoman akçe struck from?
questions.x: Akçe gümüş bir sikkeydi; altın para “sultani” idi.
questions.xe: The akçe was silver; the gold coin was the sultani.

questions.t: Yeniçeriler hoşnutsuzluklarını nasıl gösterirdi?
questions.e: How did the Janissaries signal discontent?
questions.xe: Overturning the soup cauldron meant revolt.

questions.t: Devşirme ile toplanan çocuklar en çok hangi ocağa yetiştirilirdi?
questions.e: Boys taken through the devşirme were mostly trained for which corps?
questions.x: Kapıkulu askeri, başta yeniçeri olarak yetişirlerdi.
questions.xe: They became household troops, above all Janissaries.

questions.t: Tımar sahibi sipahi, toprağın gelirine karşılık ne yapardı?
questions.e: In return for his land revenue, what did a timar-holder provide?
questions.x: Gelire göre cebelü denilen atlı askerler getirirdi.
questions.xe: He brought armed horsemen in proportion to his income.

questions.t: Süleymaniye Camii'nin mimarı kimdir?
questions.e: Who was the architect of the Süleymaniye Mosque?
questions.xe: It was completed in 1557.

questions.t: Sultanahmet Camii'ni hangi padişah yaptırdı?
questions.e: Which sultan built the Sultan Ahmed (Blue) Mosque?
questions.xe: Built between 1609 and 1617.

questions.t: İstanbul kuşatmasındaki dev topları döken usta kimdi?
questions.e: Who cast the giant cannons for the siege of Constantinople?
questions.xe: Orban's guns battered the walls.

questions.t: Fatih Sultan Mehmed gemileri karadan yürüterek nereye indirdi?
questions.e: Where did Mehmed II lower his ships after hauling them overland?
oe: the Asian shore of the Bosphorus
questions.x: Zincirle kapalı Haliç'e gemiler karadan indirildi.
questions.xe: Ships were hauled overland into the chained-off Golden Horn.

questions.t: İlk resmî Osmanlı gazetesi hangisidir?
questions.e: Which was the first official Ottoman newspaper?
questions.xe: First issued in 1831 under Mahmud II.

questions.t: Tanzimat Fermanı hangi yıl ilan edildi?
questions.e: In which year was the Tanzimat Edict proclaimed?
questions.xe: It was read out at Gülhane.

questions.t: Osmanlı'nın ilk anayasası Kanun-i Esasi hangi yıl ilan edildi?
questions.e: In which year was the first Ottoman constitution, the Kanun-i Esasi, proclaimed?
questions.xe: At the start of Abdülhamid II's reign.

questions.t: Osmanlı'nın son padişahı kimdir?
questions.e: Who was the last Ottoman sultan?
questions.x: Abdülmecid Efendi padişah değil, son halifeydi.
questions.xe: Abdülmecid Efendi was the last caliph, not a sultan.

questions.t: Saltanat hangi tarihte kaldırıldı?
questions.e: On what date was the sultanate abolished?
questions.xe: The caliphate followed on 3 March 1924.

questions.t: Lale Devri'nin ünlü şairi kimdir?
questions.e: Who was the famous poet of the Tulip Era?
questions.x: Nedim, Sadabad'ı ve İstanbul eğlencelerini yazdı.
questions.xe: Nedim wrote of Sadabad and Istanbul's pleasures.

questions.t: Barbaros Hayreddin Paşa'nın asıl adı nedir?
questions.e: What was Hayreddin Barbarossa's original name?
questions.xe: Oruç was his elder brother.

questions.t: Kanuni Sultan Süleyman hangi kuşatma sırasında vefat etti?
questions.e: During which siege did Suleiman die?
questions.xe: In 1566, just before the fortress fell.

questions.t: Topkapı Sarayı'nda Divan'ın toplandığı bölümün adı nedir?
questions.e: What is the hall in Topkapı where the council met?
questions.xe: Kubbealtı became a name for the council itself.

questions.t: İznik hangi padişah döneminde Osmanlı topraklarına katıldı?
questions.e: Under which ruler did İznik (Nicaea) join Ottoman lands?
questions.xe: Orhan took İznik in 1331.

questions.t: Çimpe Kalesi'nin alınmasıyla Osmanlılar ilk kez nereye ayak bastı?
questions.e: With the capture of Çimpe Castle, where did the Ottomans first set foot?
questions.x: 1352'de Çimpe Kalesi, Osmanlı'nın Rumeli'deki ilk toprağı oldu.
questions.xe: In 1352 Çimpe Castle became the first Ottoman foothold in Rumelia.

questions.t: Niğbolu Savaşı hangi yıl yapıldı?
questions.e: In which year was the Battle of Nicopolis fought?
questions.x: Yıldırım Bayezid, Haçlı ordusunu 1396'da Niğbolu'da yendi.
questions.xe: Bayezid I defeated the crusader army at Nicopolis in 1396.

questions.t: Varna Savaşı'nı (1444) hangi padişah yönetti?
questions.e: Which sultan led the Ottomans at the Battle of Varna (1444)?
questions.x: II. Murad, Haçlı ordusunu Varna'da yendi.
questions.xe: Murad II defeated the crusader army at Varna.

questions.t: İkinci Kosova Savaşı hangi yıl yapıldı?
questions.e: In which year was the Second Battle of Kosovo fought?
questions.xe: Murad II defeated the Hungarian-Polish army in 1448.

questions.t: Otlukbeli Savaşı Osmanlılar ile kim arasında yapıldı?
questions.e: Against whom was the Battle of Otlukbeli fought?
questions.xe: Mehmed II defeated Uzun Hasan at Otlukbeli in 1473.

questions.t: Fatih Sultan Mehmed Trabzon Rum İmparatorluğu'nu hangi yıl fethetti?
questions.e: In which year did Mehmed II conquer the Empire of Trebizond?
questions.xe: He conquered it in 1461, eight years after Constantinople.

questions.t: Kefe Kalesi hangi padişah döneminde Osmanlı'ya katıldı?
questions.e: Under which sultan did Kefe (Caffa) join the Ottoman realm?
questions.x: 1475'te Kefe alındı, Karadeniz'in kıyıları Osmanlı'nın eline geçti.
questions.xe: Kefe was taken in 1475, bringing the Black Sea coast under Ottoman control.

questions.t: Mohaç Savaşı'ndan sonra topraklarının büyük bölümü Osmanlı etkisine giren ülke hangisidir?
questions.e: Which country came largely under Ottoman influence after the Battle of Mohács?
questions.x: 1526 Mohaç zaferiyle Macaristan'ın büyük bölümü Osmanlı etkisine girdi.
questions.xe: The 1526 victory at Mohács brought most of Hungary under Ottoman influence.

questions.t: Rodos Adası'nı Osmanlılara kim fethetti?
questions.e: Who conquered the island of Rhodes for the Ottomans?
questions.x: Kanuni 1522'de Rodos'u St. Jean Şövalyelerinden aldı.
questions.xe: Suleiman took Rhodes from the Knights of St. John in 1522.

questions.t: Kıbrıs Osmanlı'ya hangi padişah döneminde katıldı?
questions.e: Under which sultan did Cyprus join the Ottoman realm?
questions.xe: It was taken from Venice in 1571, under Selim II.

questions.t: İnebahtı Deniz Savaşı'nda (1571) Osmanlı donanmasını kim komuta ediyordu?
questions.e: Who commanded the Ottoman fleet at the Battle of Lepanto (1571)?
questions.x: Müezzinzade Ali Paşa savaşta şehit düştü.
questions.xe: Müezzinzade Ali Pasha fell in the battle.

questions.t: Eğri (Eger) Kalesi'nin fethi hangi padişah döneminde oldu?
questions.e: Under which sultan was the fortress of Eger (Eğri) conquered?
questions.xe: In 1596 Mehmed III personally joined the campaign.

questions.t: Zitvatorok Antlaşması hangi devletle imzalandı?
questions.e: With which state was the Treaty of Zsitvatorok signed?
questions.xe: It was signed with Habsburg Austria in 1606.

questions.t: Girit Adası'nın fethi kaç yıl sürdü?
questions.e: How many years did the conquest of Crete take?
questions.xe: From 1645 to 1669, completed with the Siege of Candia.

questions.t: Girit'in fethini tamamlayan sadrazam kimdir?
questions.e: Which grand vizier completed the conquest of Crete?
questions.xe: He took Candia in 1669.

questions.t: Köprülü Mehmed Paşa hangi padişah döneminde sadrazam oldu?
questions.e: Under which sultan did Köprülü Mehmed Pasha become grand vizier?
questions.x: 1656'da IV. Mehmed'in annesi Turhan Sultan onu atadı.
questions.xe: In 1656 Mehmed IV's mother, Turhan Sultan, appointed him.

questions.t: Pasarofça Antlaşması hangi yıl imzalandı?
questions.e: In which year was the Treaty of Passarowitz signed?
questions.xe: This treaty is taken to mark the start of the Tulip Era.

questions.t: Belgrad Antlaşması hangi yıl imzalandı?
questions.e: In which year was the Treaty of Belgrade signed?
questions.xe: The Ottomans retook Belgrade from Austria.

questions.t: Küçük Kaynarca Antlaşması hangi yıl imzalandı?
questions.e: In which year was the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca signed?
questions.x: Kırım'ın bağımsızlığı tanındı, Rusya'ya önemli haklar verildi.
questions.xe: Crimea's independence was recognised and Russia gained major rights.

questions.t: Küçük Kaynarca Antlaşması hangi devletle imzalandı?
questions.e: With which state was the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca signed?
questions.x: I. Abdülhamid döneminde Rusya ile imzalandı.
questions.xe: It was signed with Russia under Abdülhamid I.

questions.t: Kırım hangi yıl Osmanlı etkisinden çıkıp Rusya'ya ilhak edildi?
questions.e: In which year was Crimea annexed by Russia?
questions.x: Küçük Kaynarca'dan 9 yıl sonra ilhak edildi.
questions.xe: It was annexed nine years after Küçük Kaynarca.

questions.t: Yeniçeri Ocağı'nın kaldırılması hangi isimle anılır?
questions.e: By what name is the abolition of the Janissary Corps known?
questions.x: 1826'da II. Mahmud tarafından 'Hayırlı Olay' olarak adlandırıldı.
questions.xe: Mahmud II called it the 'Auspicious Incident' in 1826.

questions.t: Tanzimat Fermanı'nı Gülhane'de kim okudu?
questions.e: Who read out the Tanzimat Edict at Gülhane?
questions.xe: He read it at Gülhane in 1839.

questions.t: Islahat Fermanı hangi yıl ilan edildi?
questions.e: In which year was the Reform Edict (Islahat Fermanı) proclaimed?
questions.x: Kırım Savaşı sonrası, Paris Antlaşması öncesinde ilan edildi.
questions.xe: It was proclaimed after the Crimean War, just before the Treaty of Paris.

questions.t: Birinci Meşrutiyet hangi yıl ilan edildi?
questions.e: In which year was the First Constitutional Era proclaimed?
questions.x: II. Abdülhamid tahta çıktığında ilan etti.
questions.xe: Abdülhamid II proclaimed it upon taking the throne.

questions.t: İkinci Meşrutiyet hangi yıl ilan edildi?
questions.e: In which year was the Second Constitutional Era proclaimed?
questions.x: İttihat ve Terakki'nin baskısıyla II. Abdülhamid yeniden ilan etti.
questions.xe: Abdülhamid II re-proclaimed it under pressure from the Committee of Union and Progress.

questions.t: İlk Osmanlı anayasası Kanun-i Esasi'yi kim hazırlamıştır?
questions.e: Who drafted the first Ottoman constitution, the Kanun-i Esasi?
questions.xe: It was adopted in 1876.

questions.t: Sened-i İttifak hangi padişah döneminde imzalandı?
questions.e: Under which sultan was the Deed of Alliance (Sened-i İttifak) signed?
questions.x: 1808'de ayanlarla imzalandı, padişah yetkisini ilk kez sınırladı.
questions.xe: Signed with the provincial notables in 1808, it first limited the sultan's authority.

questions.t: III. Selim'in kurduğu modern ordunun adı nedir?
questions.e: What was the name of the modern army Selim III founded?
questions.x: Yeniçerilerin tepkisiyle karşılaştı, III. Selim sonunda tahttan indirildi.
questions.xe: It met Janissary resistance, and Selim III was eventually dethroned.

questions.t: Yeniçeri Ocağı'nın yerine kurulan yeni ordunun adı nedir?
questions.e: What was the new army founded to replace the Janissary Corps called?
questions.xe: Mahmud II founded it in 1826.

questions.t: Mimar Sinan kaç padişahın döneminde baş mimarlık yapmıştır?
questions.e: Under how many sultans did Mimar Sinan serve as chief architect?
questions.x: Kanuni, II. Selim ve III. Murad dönemlerinde görev yaptı.
questions.xe: He served under Suleiman I, Selim II and Murad III.

questions.t: Mimar Sinan'ın kendi 'çıraklık eserim' dediği cami hangisidir?
questions.e: Which mosque did Sinan call his own 'apprentice work'?
questions.x: Kanuni'nin oğlu Şehzade Mehmed için yaptırdığı camidir.
questions.xe: He built it for Suleiman's son, Şehzade Mehmed.

questions.t: Topkapı Sarayı'nda padişah ailesinin yaşadığı bölüme ne ad verilir?
questions.e: What is the section of Topkapı Palace where the sultan's family lived called?
questions.x: Harem, padişah ailesinin özel yaşam alanıdır.
questions.xe: The Harem was the private living quarters of the sultan's family.

questions.t: Enderun Mektebi'nde başlıca kimler yetiştirilirdi?
questions.e: Who was mainly trained at the Enderun school?
questions.x: Devşirme kökenli gençler burada eğitilip üst düzey görevlere hazırlanırdı.
questions.xe: Devşirme-origin youths were trained here for high office.

questions.t: Divan-ı Hümayun'un toplandığı yere ne ad verilir?
questions.e: What is the hall where the Imperial Council met called?
questions.x: Kubbenin altında toplandığı için bu adı almıştır.
questions.xe: It took its name from the dome above the hall.

questions.t: Bab-ı Ali ne anlama gelir?
questions.e: What did Bab-ı Ali ('the Sublime Porte') refer to?
oe: the grand vizier's seat of government
questions.xe: It was used to mean the centre of the Ottoman government.

questions.t: Kapıkulu askerlerinin maaşına ne ad verilirdi?
questions.e: What was the pay of the Kapıkulu soldiers called?
questions.x: Üç ayda bir ulufe dağıtımı yapılırdı.
questions.xe: Ulufe was distributed every three months.

questions.t: Gayrimüslimlerden alınan baş vergisine ne ad verilirdi?
questions.e: What was the poll tax collected from non-Muslims called?
questions.xe: It was levied on non-Muslim men who did not perform military service.

questions.t: Kâtip Çelebi'nin Osmanlı tarihini anlatan eseri hangisidir?
questions.e: Which of Kâtip Çelebi's works recounts Ottoman history?
questions.xe: Fezleke is his work recounting Ottoman history.

questions.t: Evliya Çelebi kaç yıl boyunca seyahat ettiği söylenir?
questions.e: For roughly how many years is Evliya Çelebi said to have travelled?
questions.x: 17. yüzyılda Osmanlı topraklarını ve ötesini gezdi.
questions.xe: In the 17th century he travelled through and beyond Ottoman lands.

questions.t: Takiyüddin Mehmed hangi alanda ünlüdür?
questions.e: In which field was Takiyüddin Mehmed renowned?
questions.xe: He founded an observatory in Istanbul in 1577.

questions.t: İstanbul Rasathanesi hangi padişah döneminde yıktırıldı?
questions.e: Under which sultan was the Istanbul Observatory demolished?
questions.x: Kurulduktan kısa süre sonra, III. Murad'ın emriyle yıktırıldı.
questions.xe: It was demolished by Murad III's order shortly after it was built.

questions.t: Matbaa-i Amire (İbrahim Müteferrika'nın matbaası) hangi padişah döneminde kuruldu?
questions.e: Under which sultan was the Matbaa-i Amire (İbrahim Müteferrika's press) founded?
questions.xe: İbrahim Müteferrika was granted permission in 1727.

questions.t: Tercüman-ı Ahval hangi özelliğiyle bilinir?
questions.e: For what is Tercüman-ı Ahval known?
questions.xe: Şinasi and Agah Efendi published it in 1860.

questions.t: Divan edebiyatının en yaygın kısa nazım biçimi hangisidir?
questions.e: What is the most common short verse form of Divan literature?
questions.x: Aşk ve güzellik temalı kısa şiir biçimidir.
questions.xe: It is a short poem form on themes of love and beauty.

questions.t: Baki, Kanuni döneminde hangi unvanla anılırdı?
questions.e: By what title was the poet Baki known in Suleiman's reign?
questions.x: Kanuni dönemi divan şairidir, 'şairler sultanı' unvanıyla anılır.
questions.xe: A Divan poet of Suleiman's era, known as the 'Sultan of Poets'.

questions.t: Fuzuli'nin en ünlü mesnevisi hangisidir?
questions.e: What is Fuzuli's most famous narrative poem?
questions.x: Mesnevi tarzında yazılmış ünlü bir aşk hikâyesidir.
questions.xe: It is a famous love story written in the mesnevi form.

questions.t: Kanuni Sultan Süleyman'ın şiirlerinde kullandığı mahlas nedir?
questions.e: What pen name did Suleiman the Magnificent use in his poetry?
questions.xe: Suleiman used the pen name 'Muhibbi' in his poems.

questions.t: Fatih Sultan Mehmed'in şiirlerinde kullandığı mahlas nedir?
questions.e: What pen name did Mehmed the Conqueror use in his poetry?
questions.xe: Mehmed II's pen name in his poems was Avni.

questions.t: II. Bayezid'in şiirlerinde kullandığı mahlas nedir?
questions.e: What pen name did Bayezid II use in his poetry?
questions.xe: Bayezid II used the pen name 'Adli' in his poems.

questions.t: 16. yüzyıl saray nakkaşhanesinin en önemli ustalarından biri kimdir?
questions.e: Who was one of the leading masters of the 16th-century palace studio of miniature painting?
questions.x: Surname-i Hümayun gibi eserlere minyatür yaptı.
questions.xe: He painted miniatures for works such as the Surname-i Hümayun.

questions.t: Osmanlı hat sanatının öncülerinden sayılan, II. Bayezid dönemi hattatı kimdir?
questions.e: Who is the calligrapher of Bayezid II's era regarded as a pioneer of Ottoman calligraphy?
questions.xe: He is regarded as the forefather of later calligraphers.

questions.t: Matrakçı Nasuh hangi alanlarıyla tanınır?
questions.e: For which fields is Matrakçı Nasuh known?
questions.x: Seferleri minyatürle resmeden tarihçi ve matematikçidir.
questions.xe: He was a historian and mathematician who depicted campaigns in miniatures.

questions.t: Mehter takımının temel nefesli çalgılarından biri hangisidir?
questions.e: Which is one of the main wind instruments of the Mehter band?
questions.x: Zurna, davul ve nakkare mehterin temel çalgılarındandır.
questions.xe: The zurna, davul and nakkare are among the Mehter's core instruments.

questions.t: Mehterhanenin kaldırılmasının ardından kurulan Batı tarzı bandonun adı nedir?
questions.e: What was the Western-style band founded after the Mehter was abolished called?
questions.x: II. Mahmud, Yeniçeriyle birlikte mehteri de kaldırıp bu bandoyu kurdurdu.
questions.xe: Mahmud II abolished the Mehter along with the Janissaries and founded this band.

questions.t: Kahve, Osmanlı sarayına yaklaşık hangi yüzyılda girmiştir?
questions.e: In roughly which century did coffee reach the Ottoman palace?
questions.xe: It reached Istanbul by way of Yemen.

questions.t: Lale Devri hangi antlaşmanın ardından başlatıldığı kabul edilir?
questions.e: After which treaty is the Tulip Era considered to have begun?
questions.x: 1718 Pasarofça Antlaşması'ndan sonra başladığı kabul edilir.
questions.xe: It is considered to have begun after the 1718 Treaty of Passarowitz.

questions.t: Osmanlı'da akçenin değer kaybetmesinin ardından öne çıkan gümüş para birimi hangisidir?
questions.e: Which silver currency came to prominence after the akçe lost value?
questions.xe: The kuruş rose to prominence after the 17th century.

questions.t: Osmanlı'nın altın sikkesinin adı nedir?
questions.e: What was the name of the Ottoman gold coin?
questions.x: Fatih döneminden itibaren basılan altın sikkedir.
questions.xe: It was a gold coin minted from Mehmed II's reign onward.

questions.t: Kapalıçarşı'nın yapımına hangi padişah döneminde başlanmıştır?
questions.e: Under which sultan did construction of the Grand Bazaar begin?
questions.x: İstanbul'un fethinden sonra ticareti canlandırmak için yaptırıldı.
questions.xe: It was built to revive trade after the conquest of Istanbul.

questions.t: Süleymaniye Külliyesi'nde cami dışında neler bulunur?
questions.e: Besides the mosque, what does the Süleymaniye complex include?
oe: Buildings such as a madrasa, hospital and soup kitchen
questions.x: Külliye, birçok sosyal hizmet binasını bir arada barındırır.
questions.xe: The complex houses many social-service buildings together.

questions.t: Mihrimah Sultan Camii'nin mimarı kimdir?
questions.e: Who was the architect of the Mihrimah Sultan Mosque?
questions.x: Sinan, Kanuni'nin kızı Mihrimah Sultan için iki cami yaptı.
questions.xe: Sinan built two mosques for Mihrimah Sultan, Suleiman's daughter.

questions.t: Yavuz Sultan Selim'in saltanatı yaklaşık kaç yıl sürdü?
questions.e: Roughly how many years did Selim I's reign last?
questions.x: 1512-1520 arası, kısa ama fetihlerle dolu bir saltanattı.
questions.xe: From 1512 to 1520, a short but conquest-filled reign.

questions.t: Yavuz Sultan Selim'den sonra tahta kim geçmiştir?
questions.e: Who succeeded Selim I on the throne?
questions.x: Yavuz'un tek oğlu Süleyman, 1520'de tahta çıktı.
questions.xe: Selim's only son, Suleiman, took the throne in 1520.
